Doctoral Degree Programs
At UMass Dartmouth, our doctoral degree programs prepare you to become a leader in research, scholarship, and professional practice. Whether you are advancing breakthroughs in science and engineering, driving innovation in healthcare, shaping policy, or leading change in education, a UMassD doctorate gives you the expertise and experience to make an impact.
Guided by faculty who are active researchers and thought leaders, our PhD, EdD, DNP, and JD programs combine rigorous academics with hands-on discovery. You’ll work in state-of-the-art labs, collaborate across disciplines, and connect with industry and community partners throughout Massachusetts and beyond. Many of our programs also offer flexible formats—including online and hybrid pathways—designed to meet the needs of working professionals.
From biomedical engineering to nursing, from law to marine science, UMass Dartmouth offers doctoral programs that reflect today’s most pressing challenges and tomorrow’s opportunities. By earning your doctorate here, you will join a community of scholars and professionals dedicated to advancing knowledge and solving real-world problems.

Graduate
Biomedical Engineering and Biotechnology MS, PhD
UMass Dartmouth’s doctoral program (PhD) in Biomedical Engineering & Biotechnology addresses contemporary health research problems and educates biomedical and biotechnology researchers.
Learn more
Graduate
Chemistry and Biochemistry PhD
Pursue your PhD in chemistry or biochemistry. The doctoral program’s strengths include marine chemistry, inorganic and organic chemistry, and environmental chemistry.
Learn more
Graduate
Educational Leadership and Policy Studies EdD (Hybrid)
The EdD program at UMass Dartmouth cultivates leaders in education through interdisciplinary study, expert faculty, and collaborative partnerships for social justice.
Learn more
Graduate
Electrical Engineering PhD
The PhD program in Electrical Engineering provides individualized education and independent study for researchers and leaders in the field.
Learn more
Graduate
Engineering and Applied Science PhD
The PhD degree program in Engineering and Applied Science (EAS) features contemporary, advanced interdisciplinary research and educational opportunities.
Learn more
Graduate
Integrative Biology PhD
The PhD program in integrative biology challenges students to conduct research from diverse biological perspectives and prepares students for careers in academia, government and industry.
Learn more
Graduate
Intercampus Marine Science Programs MS, PhD
The multidisciplinary program focuses on the aquatic ecosystem and its contribution to humanity and provides a unique learning experience for students and professors alike who engage with local, regional, and worldwide partners.
Learn more
Graduate
Juris Doctor & Master of Social Work JD, MSW
Enroll in the Master of Social Work program and the traditional Juris Doctor program simultaneously to earn two degrees that complement each other simultaneously.
Learn more
Graduate
Law JD
Earn a Juris Doctor degree from UMass Law. Master essential legal skills, learn the fundamentals of statutory and case law, and explore new and emerging areas of practice.
Learn more
Graduate
Luso-Afro-Brazilian Studies & Theory PhD
Pursue a PhD in Luso-Afro-Brazilian Studies and Theory at UMass Dartmouth’s Department of Portuguese, the largest Portuguese program in the US.
Learn more
Graduate
Marine Science and Technology PhD
Earn your PhD in marine science and technology at UMassD-SMAST and conduct research to address real-world ocean challenges.
Learn more
Graduate
Nursing PhD
Prepare to be a Nurse Scientist Educator with UMass Dartmouth’s Nursing PhD program. This program is research-based, focused on chronic illness & leadership in nursing education.
Learn more
Graduate
Nursing—Doctor of Nursing Practice DNP Online
The Doctor of Nursing Practice (DNP) online graduate degree program prepares nurses to become nurse practitioners, clinical nurse educators, and leaders in healthcare.
Learn more
Graduate
STEM Education PhD
Transform the field of education with a STEM Education PhD from UMass Dartmouth. Develop critical-thinking skills and engage in real-world research projects to improve STEM education at all levels.
Learn more
Graduate
University of São Paulo Dual PhD
The dual-degree framework allows graduate students to participate in the program at each institution, while being co-supervised by one faculty member from each institution
Learn more
